questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Rarely does the company achieves such remarkable growth.
questions.explanation: Topic: Negative Inversion. EN: After negative adverbials like 'Rarely', we use subject-auxiliary inversion. The main verb must be in the base form, not the third-person singular. ID: Setelah kata keterangan negatif seperti 'Rarely', kita menggunakan inversi subjek-auksiliari. Kata kerja utama harus dalam bentuk dasar, bukan bentuk orang ketiga tunggal.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: If she has studied harder, she would be passing the exam now.
questions.explanation: Topic: Mixed Conditionals. EN: This is a mixed conditional. The 'if' clause refers to a past unreal situation requiring the past perfect tense, while the main clause refers to a present unreal result. ID: Ini adalah pengandaian campuran. Klausa 'if' merujuk pada situasi masa lalu yang tidak nyata yang membutuhkan tenses past perfect, sedangkan klausa utama merujuk pada hasil masa kini yang tidak nyata.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: The committee recommended that the new policy is implemented immediately.
questions.explanation: Topic: Mandative Subjunctive. EN: Verbs of recommending, suggesting, or demanding trigger the mandative subjunctive mood in the 'that' clause, which requires the base form of the verb regardless of the subject. ID: Kata kerja yang menyatakan rekomendasi, saran, atau tuntutan memicu modus subjungtif mandatif dalam klausa 'that', yang mengharuskan penggunaan bentuk dasar kata kerja tanpa memandang subjeknya.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: It were the CEO who made the final decision regarding the merger.
questions.explanation: Topic: Cleft Sentences. EN: In 'It-cleft' sentences used for emphasis, the verb 'be' must agree with the emphasized noun. Since 'the CEO' is singular, 'was' is required. ID: Dalam kalimat 'It-cleft' yang digunakan untuk penekanan, kata kerja 'be' harus sesuai dengan kata benda yang ditekankan. Karena 'the CEO' adalah tunggal, 'was' diperlukan.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Startling by the sudden noise, the baby woke up crying.
questions.explanation: Topic: Past Participle Clauses. EN: A past participle is used here with a passive meaning (the baby was startled). 'Startling' would incorrectly imply the baby was causing the startle. ID: Past participle digunakan di sini dengan makna pasif (bayi itu dikagetkan). 'Startling' akan secara tidak tepat menyiratkan bahwa bayi tersebut yang mengejutkan.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: The ground is completely wet. It should have rained heavily last night.
questions.explanation: Topic: Modals of Past Deduction. EN: 'Must have' plus a past participle is used to express a strong logical deduction about a past event based on present evidence. 'Should have' implies an unfulfilled expectation. ID: 'Must have' ditambah past participle digunakan untuk menyatakan deduksi logis yang kuat tentang peristiwa masa lalu berdasarkan bukti saat ini. 'Should have' menyiratkan harapan yang tidak terpenuhi.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Inexperienced although he is, he handled the crisis remarkably well.
questions.explanation: Topic: Advanced Concessive Clauses. EN: The formal concessive structure is 'Adjective + as + subject + be'. 'Although' is not used in this specific fronted adjective structure. ID: Struktur konsesif formal adalah 'Adjective + as + subject + be'. 'Although' tidak digunakan dalam struktur kata sifat yang diletakkan di depan secara spesifik ini.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Was I to ask for a favor, I would call you.
questions.explanation: Topic: Inverted Conditionals. EN: In formal inverted conditionals, 'Were' is used for all subjects, including 'I'. 'Was' is grammatically incorrect in this subjunctive structure. ID: Dalam pengandaian inversi formal, 'Were' digunakan untuk semua subjek, termasuk 'I'. 'Was' secara tata bahasa tidak tepat dalam struktur subjungtif ini.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: I need to get my car repairing before the road trip.
questions.explanation: Topic: Passive Causative. EN: The passive causative structure 'get + object + past participle' is used when you arrange for someone else to perform a service for you. ID: Struktur kausatif pasif 'get + objek + past participle' digunakan ketika Anda mengatur agar orang lain melakukan layanan untuk Anda.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: The artifacts discovering in the tomb date back to the Ming Dynasty.
questions.explanation: Topic: Reduced Relative Clauses. EN: The relative clause 'which were discovered' is reduced to the past participle 'discovered' because the artifacts received the action, indicating a passive meaning. ID: Klausa relatif 'which were discovered' direduksi menjadi past participle 'discovered' karena artefak tersebut menerima tindakan, yang menunjukkan makna pasif.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: By the end of this year, I will be working at this company for a decade.
tokens: By the end of this year,
questions.explanation: Topic: Future Perfect Continuous. EN: The future perfect continuous tense is required to emphasize the duration of an action up to a specific point in the future. ID: Tenses future perfect continuous diperlukan untuk menekankan durasi suatu tindakan hingga titik tertentu di masa depan.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: It is imperative that every employee reads the safety manual.
questions.explanation: Topic: Subjunctive in Noun Clauses. EN: Adjectives expressing urgency trigger the subjunctive mood in the following 'that' clause, requiring the base form of the verb for all subjects. ID: Kata sifat yang menyatakan urgensi memicu modus subjungtif dalam klausa 'that' berikutnya, yang mengharuskan penggunaan bentuk dasar kata kerja untuk semua subjek.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Not only he finished the project on time, but he also came in under budget.
questions.explanation: Topic: Negative Inversion. EN: When a sentence begins with 'Not only', subject-auxiliary inversion is strictly required in the first clause. ID: Ketika sebuah kalimat diawali dengan 'Not only', inversi subjek-auksiliari diwajibkan secara ketat pada klausa pertama.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: I regret informing you that your application has been rejected.
questions.explanation: Topic: Verb Patterns (Regret). EN: 'Regret' plus a to-infinitive is used to formally announce bad news. 'Regret' plus a gerund is used to express remorse for a past action you already did. ID: 'Regret' ditambah to-infinitive digunakan untuk mengumumkan kabar buruk secara formal. 'Regret' ditambah gerund digunakan untuk menyatakan penyesalan atas tindakan masa lalu yang sudah Anda lakukan.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: The suspect believes to have fled the country last night.
questions.explanation: Topic: Impersonal Passive. EN: The impersonal passive structure 'is believed to have' plus a past participle is used for reporting verbs when the subject of the belief is unknown or general. ID: Struktur pasif impersonal 'is believed to have' ditambah past participle digunakan untuk kata kerja pelaporan ketika subjek dari kepercayaan tersebut tidak diketahui atau bersifat umum.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: If we have known about the traffic, we would have taken the train.
questions.explanation: Topic: Type 3 Conditionals. EN: Type 3 conditionals refer to unreal past situations, requiring the past perfect tense in the 'if' clause, not the present perfect. ID: Pengandaian Tipe 3 merujuk pada situasi masa lalu yang tidak nyata, yang membutuhkan tenses past perfect dalam klausa 'if', bukan present perfect.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: People say he does not care about the environment, but he is care.
tokens: People say he does not care
questions.explanation: Topic: Emphatic Do. EN: The auxiliary 'do', 'does', or 'did' is used before a main verb to add strong emphasis, contradicting a previous negative statement. 'Is' cannot be used with a base verb. ID: Kata kerja bantu 'do', 'does', atau 'did' digunakan sebelum kata kerja utama untuk memberikan penekanan kuat, membantah pernyataan negatif sebelumnya. 'Is' tidak dapat digunakan dengan kata kerja dasar.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: We had the plumber fixed the leaking pipe yesterday.
questions.explanation: Topic: Active Causative. EN: The active causative structure 'have' plus a person plus a base verb is used when you arrange for someone specific to do something for you. ID: Struktur kausatif aktif 'have' ditambah orang ditambah kata kerja dasar digunakan ketika Anda mengatur agar orang tertentu melakukan sesuatu untuk Anda.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Suffices it to say, the results were disastrous.
questions.explanation: Topic: Formulaic Subjunctive. EN: 'Suffice it to say' is a fixed idiomatic expression using the subjunctive mood, meaning it is enough to say. The verb remains in the base form. ID: 'Suffice it to say' adalah ekspresi idiomatis tetap yang menggunakan modus subjungtif, yang berarti cukuplah untuk dikatakan. Kata kerja tetap dalam bentuk dasar.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Not only the students but also the principal were invited to the gala.
questions.explanation: Topic: Correlative Subject-Verb Agreement. EN: With correlative conjunctions like 'not only... but also', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. 'The principal' is singular, so 'was' is correct. ID: Dengan konjungsi korelatif seperti 'not only... but also', kata kerja harus sesuai dengan subjek yang paling dekat dengannya. 'The principal' adalah tunggal, jadi 'was' adalah yang benar.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Neither of the two candidates were considered suitable for the position.
questions.explanation: Topic: Indefinite Pronoun Agreement. EN: 'Neither of' takes a singular verb in formal English. Therefore, the plural 'were' should be the singular 'was'. ID: 'Neither of' menggunakan kata kerja tunggal dalam bahasa Inggris formal. Oleh karena itu, 'were' yang jamak seharusnya diganti dengan 'was' yang tunggal.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: The number of students enrolled in the advanced course have increased significantly this year.
questions.explanation: Topic: Quantifier Agreement. EN: 'The number of' is treated as a singular subject and requires a singular verb. In contrast, 'A number of' takes a plural verb. ID: 'The number of' dianggap sebagai subjek tunggal dan membutuhkan kata kerja tunggal. Sebaliknya, 'A number of' menggunakan kata kerja jamak.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Scarcely had we arrived at the station when the train has already left.
questions.explanation: Topic: Past Perfect with Scarcely. EN: In 'Scarcely had... when...' structures, both actions happened in the past. The earlier action requires the past perfect tense, not the present perfect. ID: Dalam struktur 'Scarcely had... when...', kedua tindakan terjadi di masa lalu. Tindakan yang terjadi lebih dulu membutuhkan tenses past perfect, bukan present perfect.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: In despite of the heavy rain, the outdoor concert went on as planned.
questions.explanation: Topic: Prepositions of Concession. EN: The correct phrase is 'In spite of' or simply 'Despite'. 'In despite of' is a grammatically incorrect hybrid of the two. ID: Frasa yang benar adalah 'In spite of' atau cukup 'Despite'. 'In despite of' adalah gabungan yang salah secara tata bahasa dari keduanya.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Each of the employees are required to submit a report.
questions.explanation: Topic: Subject-Verb Agreement (Each). EN: 'Each' is a singular indefinite pronoun and requires a singular verb, regardless of the plural noun in the prepositional phrase. ID: 'Each' adalah kata ganti tak tentu tunggal dan membutuhkan kata kerja tunggal, tanpa memandang kata benda jamak dalam frasa preposisional.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: The professor, along with his teaching assistants, are going to attend the conference in Geneva.
questions.explanation: Topic: Intervening Phrases Agreement. EN: Intervening phrases like 'along with', 'as well as', and 'together with' do not change the number of the subject. 'The professor' is singular, so the verb must be 'is'. ID: Frasa penyela seperti 'along with', 'as well as', dan 'together with' tidak mengubah jumlah subjek. 'The professor' adalah tunggal, jadi kata kerjanya harus 'is'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Hardly had I sat down to eat than the phone rang.
questions.explanation: Topic: Correlative Conjunctions. EN: The correct correlative pairing is 'Hardly... when' or 'No sooner... than'. 'Than' is incorrect when paired with 'Hardly'. ID: Pasangan korelatif yang benar adalah 'Hardly... when' atau 'No sooner... than'. 'Than' tidak tepat digunakan ketika dipasangkan dengan 'Hardly'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: The data collected by the researchers shows that the climate are changing rapidly.
tokens: The data collected by the researchers
questions.explanation: Topic: Uncountable Noun Agreement. EN: 'The climate' is a singular uncountable noun and requires the singular verb 'is', not the plural 'are'. ID: 'The climate' adalah kata benda tak dapat dihitung yang tunggal dan membutuhkan kata kerja tunggal 'is', bukan 'are' yang jamak.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Not only she won the competition, but she also broke the national record.
questions.explanation: Topic: Inversion with Not Only. EN: When a sentence starts with 'Not only', the first clause requires subject-auxiliary inversion. ID: Ketika kalimat diawali dengan 'Not only', klausa pertama memerlukan inversi subjek-auksiliari.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: I would rather you will stay at home tonight.
questions.explanation: Topic: Subjunctive after Would Rather. EN: After 'would rather' with a different subject, we use the past subjunctive (past simple form) to express a present or future preference. ID: Setelah 'would rather' dengan subjek yang berbeda, kita menggunakan past subjunctive (bentuk past simple) untuk menyatakan preferensi masa kini atau masa depan.
